global: This is a bowl of spicy ramen with a vibrant orange broth, topped with sliced chashu pork, menma, and chopped green onions. It sits in a patterned ceramic bowl on a dark tray, under bright, even lighting that highlights the rich colors and textures.

regions.background: Black tray surface with subtle texture and slight sheen, rectangular with rounded corners.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a white base, colorful floral and scroll pattern, and a smooth, glossy rim.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green onions, bean sprouts, and a soft-boiled egg, appears rich and glossy.
regions.spoon: A light blue spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, rounded bowl shape.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, marbled texture with browned edges and a single green onion garnish on top.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a curved, layered shape and visible fibrous texture.
